### Data Explorers

- [Mex VMS explorer](https://mex-fisheries.github.io/mex_vms_explorer/)

### Datasets

- Mexican Fisheries Data ([MEX-fisheries portal](https://mex-fisheries.github.io/mex-fisheries/)):
  - Vessel Monitoring Systems (VMS) data | [link](https://mex-fisheries.github.io/mex_vms/)
  - Fisheries production (landings) data | [link](https://mex-fisheries.github.io/mex_landings/)
  - Vessel registry and permits data | [link](https://mex-fisheries.github.io/mex_vessel_registry/)
  - Location of fishing ports | [link](https://mex-fisheries.github.io/mex_ports/)
  - Location of landing sites | [link](https://mex-fisheries.github.io/mex_landing_sites/)
- Catch and effort from the world's tuna fisheries:
  - [GitHub repo](https://github.com/human-ocean/tuna_data) (dev)
  - [Zenodo](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21494710) (stable release)
  - [Usage examples](https://human-ocean.github.io/tuna_data/)

### Software

- [`EventHorizon`](https://github.com/jcvdav/EventHorizon): An R Package to build panels for event-study models based on a user-specified time horizon for repeated interventions
- [`EVR628tools`](https://github.com/jcvdav/EVR628tools): An R Package with datasets, palettes, and functions to help in the instruction of [EVR 528 / 628](https://jcvdav.github.io/EVR_628/) Introduction to Data Management and Visualization for Environmental Scientists.
